title: feat(pm): label-write --handoff — the seat's Tier H hand-off (comment + pm:awaiting-merge + review request) as one relay stroke
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

Fixes #35948

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: yes

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感。车队内部:座位把需要你批的 PR 交给你时,交接评论、等你合并的标签和给你的审核请求改成一条命令一次完成,并当场回读核对。
- 为什么做:前天有三个需要你批的 PR 只收到评论提醒,没进你的待合并清单和审核队列,空等了约四个半小时;这是座位交接流程的修补。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某次交接被这条命令拒绝、座位改回手工补写;它不合并、不放行任何东西,可整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:批准本 PR(它改了座位交接流程的条文,按规则须你批)。

## What changes

- `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --issue PR --comment-file request.md --handoff` makes the seat's Tier H hand-off (pm-dispatch 〈路径分叉〉 ② and ③) ONE relay stroke: the request comment, then `labels_add pm:awaiting-merge`, then `assign` for an approver who is the pull's author, then `pr_request_reviewers` for every other `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account not already requested, assigned or holding a submitted review.
- Refused with zero writes (exit 2) unless:
  - `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr OWNER/NAME#N --json` (spawned, so every split it chains, `Rule-change:` included, is the one reading) reads Tier H, or the size limb fires. Tier S, ungoverned and fork pulls are refused. An unanswered reading is exit 3.
  - The newest `## 席位核对` reads ACCEPT and is newer than the head's committer date (H69's comparison).
  - The newest trusted `## Contract review` naming the head reads PASS, and its `Served-tier:` stands.
  - A `## 维护者速读` comment is on the thread, or is the request itself (H48's brief half).
- Read-back: labels, assignees and comment (the fold's lines), plus `④ reviewers`, `④ H43` and `④ H48`. The last two call the patrol rows themselves (`h43GovernedReviewRequestGap`, `h48GovernedVerdictWithoutBrief`) on the pull as read back, using the tier tool's post-split slice. Any ✗ is exit 4, not repaired.
- `--handoff --dry-run` may omit `--comment-file`. It reads everything, prints `now H43` / `now H48` for the pull as it stands and the stroke it would send, and sends nothing. This is the shape chosen for To-do 3: the per-round reading of a seat's own governed pulls, without a check-half-states run (over two minutes) and without a new `--rows` mode there.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈路径分叉〉 ③: one line now points at the command (`同轮一笔 label-write.mjs --handoff 交②③`). The file is 4 bytes smaller (33863 to 33859, ceiling 33872 unchanged).

Read first, by risk:
1. `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`, `handoffGate`: the refusal order and the record readings it reuses.
2. `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`, `foldStroke`'s `--handoff` hunks: the action order and the `④ H43` / `④ H48` read-back.
3. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` line 203.

## Tests

<details><summary>label-write self-test: 371 cases across 19 batteries, exit 0 (was 339 across 18)</summary>

The new battery `--handoff: …` is pinned at 32 cases. It shows:
- `--handoff` writes all three in one dispatch, in this order: `comment` → `labels_add` → `assign` → `pr_request_reviewers`.
- The author-approver is ASSIGNED and never requested.
- Control: the fixture pull fires BOTH H43 and H48 before the hand-off, and the same row functions read `null` on the board after it.
- Refusals with zero sends, one each: Tier S, ungoverned, a PASS on an older head, no PASS, a same-head FAIL, a PASS whose Served-tier does not stand, an untrusted PASS author, REWORK, an ACCEPT older than the head, no brief, an issue, a closed pull, an unsigned request, and the direct route.
- An unanswered tier reading is exit 3.
- Idempotence: a covered approver, or the label already on, costs no action.
- A relay that skips a part reads `④ reviewers ✗` / `④ H43 ✗` or `④ labels ✗` / `④ H48 ✗`, exit 4.
- The dry run sends nothing, both before and after the hand-off.
- SKILL.md carries the pointer and the author-assign rule as substrings.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation, one-time, at 26da765b, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs (restore verified: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- `handoffReviewPlan` made to request the author (`toRequest: missing, toAssign: []`): the self-test went red on 3 cases (the plan, the stroke and the author-assigned case), then was restored.
- The `!handoff.passed` refusal disabled: the self-test went red on the same-head FAIL case (exit 0 and one send instead of exit 2 and zero), then was restored.

</details>

A read-only check of the spawn half on a merged pull: `readGovernedTier` on objectstack-ai/objectstack 35610 answered exit 3, Tier H, 5 matched rows. Per the dispatch, `--handoff` itself was never run against a real pull.

## Acceptance notes

- Mechanism readings, measured against origin/main `cbd582f4`:
  - `--land` does NOT read ACCEPT + same-head PASS. Its only gate is the dogfood battery gate. The reading lives in `check-half-states.mjs` `h43HandoffReading`, which this mode calls.
  - `fleet-write/execute.mjs` `governedReviewPlan` is not reused. Its tier half chains no `applyRuleChangeSplit`, so a `.claude/**` pull declaring `Rule-change: yes` reads Tier S there and nobody would be requested. That defect is carried by #35612, the open card for the relay review plan and H43 after the `.claude/**` split. This mode takes its tier from `check-governed-merges --pr` and its coverage union from H43's own reading.
  - For the same reason, H43 and H48 on a full patrol run still stand down on such a pull. `--handoff`'s read-back asks the same rows on the tool's post-split slice, so they judge it.
- The seat's own account is not excluded from the request: `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` holds only the maintainer's account today. A seat whose login is in that set would be requested.
- `execution-duties.md` line 17 still names the full `check-half-states.mjs` run as the per-round reader. Pointing it at `--handoff --dry-run` is a second governed text edit, outside this card's declared file surface, so it is left to the seat.

## Verification

Two minutes: `node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --self-test` should print `✓ label-write self-test: 371 cases pass across 19 batteries`.
